s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic photosensitive eruption with skin and potential muscle involvement
salient_findings: Photosensitive eruption involving face, neck, trunk, and extremities
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Diffuse poikiloderma on upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
key_facts: Previous treatments included systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, and others with minimal improvement
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic photosensitive eruption with skin and potential muscle involvement
salient_findings: Photosensitive eruption involving face, neck, trunk, and extremities
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Diffuse poikiloderma on upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
key_facts: Previous treatments included systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, and others with minimal improvement
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)

differentials: Poikiloderma of Rothmund-Thomson syndrome with myositis
Chronic granulomatous disease with photosensitive eruption
Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
Familial atypical multiple mole melanoma syndrome
per_call: Poikiloderma of Rothmund-Thomson syndrome with myositis
Chronic granulomatous disease with photosensitive eruption
Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
Familial atypical multiple mole melanoma syndrome

shortlist.label: Anti-TIF-1γ juvenile dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies and radiographic evidence of myositis

shortlist.label: Juvenile Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical examination revealed violaceous erythema, poikiloderma, and erythematous papules, consistent with dermatomyositis

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Photosensitive eruption and potential muscle involvement, although less likely given the presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies

shortlist.label: Polymorphous light eruption
shortlist.why_kept: Photosensitive eruption, but less likely given the presence of myositis and anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical examination and laboratory findings consistent with dermatomyositis, although Anti-TIF-1γ juvenile dermatomyositis is a more specific diagnosis

raw.rationale: The presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies, elevated serum IFN-β levels, and radiographic evidence of myositis, along with the patient's age and symptoms, strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Juvenile Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: While the patient has symptoms consistent with JDM, the presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies specifically points towards Anti-TIF-1γ JDM

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and laboratory findings do not strongly support SLE, particularly the absence of specific SLE criteria such as a positive ANA or dsDNA antibodies

rejected.label: Polymorphous light eruption
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings, including myositis and specific autoantibodies, are not typical of polymorphous light eruption

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: The patient's age and the presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies suggest a more specific diagnosis of Anti-TIF-1γ JDM rather than the broader category of dermatomyositis
